question: Exact Parsec peer_id format/length (buffer is 32 bytes, base62 alphabet string exists near creds) and how host_secret is derived.
probes: Capture a real /v2/hosts response to see peer_id values
resolution: host_secret rule settled (FUN_1800d0800): a value of exactly 27 base62 characters is an access_link_id, anything else is a secret; FUN_180034680 stores peer_id/host_secret only for one attempt. The peer_id generator itself lives on the server (the client only stores and forwards it, buffer up to 31 chars), so SigmaDesk keeps its own 26-char base62 id (estimated) — no interop with Parsec ids is needed.
